queries:
WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT p.death_country,
           AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE TRIM(p.death_country) <> ''
      AND v.points_won IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country,
       avg_points_won,
       ABS(avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM country_averages)) AS absolute_difference
FROM country_averages

WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT p.death_country,
           AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won
    FROM manager_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(p.death_country, '')) <> ''
      AND v.points_won IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country,
       avg_points_won,
       ABS(avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM country_averages)) AS absolute_difference
FROM country_averages

WITH votes AS (
    SELECT player_id, points_won FROM player_award_vote
    UNION ALL
    SELECT player_id, points_won FROM manager_award_vote
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT p.death_country,
           AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won
    FROM votes AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(p.death_country, '')) <> ''
      AND v.points_won IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country,
       avg_points_won,
       ABS(avg_points_won - AVG(avg_points_won) OVER ()) AS absolute_difference
FROM country_averages

WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country,
           AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
)
SELECT birth_country,
       avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM country_averages) AS signed_difference
FROM country_averages

WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country AS country,
           AVG(v.points_won) AS average_points
    FROM manager_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
)
SELECT country,
       average_points - (SELECT AVG(average_points) FROM country_averages) AS signed_difference
FROM country_averages

WITH votes AS (
    SELECT player_id, points_won FROM manager_award_vote
    UNION ALL
    SELECT player_id, points_won FROM player_award_vote
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country AS country, AVG(v.points_won) AS average_points
    FROM votes AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
)
SELECT country,
       average_points - (SELECT AVG(average_points) FROM country_averages) AS signed_difference
FROM country_averages
